Safety

Built like someone's child depends on it. Because they do.

Every promise here is enforced by the app and tested. Show this slide to your parents' committee.

Pickup codes

A child goes home only with the parent's 4-digit code. After 5 wrong tries, only an Org Admin can release them, and it is logged.

Ears for You

Any child can tell a trusted adult what is wrong, anonymously if they want. The database never reveals who they are.

Photo checks

Every picture a child uploads is checked by a grown-up before parents see it.

Private journals

Journals belong to the child. Teachers and parents cannot read them.

AI that knows its place

Champ Buddy is never given a child's name. Worrying messages never reach the AI; the club is alerted instead.

Your data, separate

Each club's data is completely separate, every sensitive action is logged, and clubs can download everything any time.

For club leaders

Your club, your colours, your phone

  • Your own Clubhouse page with logo, colour, motto, news and events.
  • A join code for parents, with approval if you want it.
  • Classes, teachers, roles and invite links in minutes.
  • Insights: who came, who has not been seen in 3 weeks, points this week.
  • Seasons, certificates, name tags and a full audit log.
Works anywhere

No app store. Just a link.

Champzz runs in the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop, and can be added to the home screen like an app. Built phone-first, tested down to small Android screens.
